  "required_fixes": [
    "R2 (remaining) — Include the automatic jar Cookie in registered-origin credential ambiguity checks. admission.rs:412-454 counts editor and auth-generated headers, but send.rs:464-474 performs that admission before loading/capturing the jar cookie. execute.rs:787-800 then adds that Cookie independently. A registered request with Basic/Bearer/manual Authorization and a matching session cookie therefore sends two credential sources; an explicit Cookie plus a jar cookie can also send conflicting Cookie sources. This violates DESIGN.md's registered-origin rule refusing a second credential and leaves credential/account precedence to the service. The new reviews_are_bound_to_the_credentials_and_cookies_actually_sent fixture already establishes the missed path: main.rs:1885-1904 populates sid=one, successfully applies a cookie-only DELETE, then successfully applies a Basic DELETE at the same host/path without clearing the jar; it asserts Basic Authorization but never checks/refuses the additional cookie. R5's stable-cookie binding does not enforce the one-credential admission rule. Acceptance: apply the ambiguity policy to the complete first-hop credential set, including the captured jar Cookie, before resolving auth secrets or dispatch. Add production-interface cases for jar-cookie plus generated/literal Authorization and jar-cookie plus explicit Cookie, requiring ambiguousCredential and no target request; preserve cookie-only and single-Authorization requests at registered origins and ordinary unregistered HTTP. Update the Basic positive control to use an unambiguous credential state."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [],
  "optional_suggestions": [],
  "limitations": [
    "Read-only independent review of scoped implementation, requirements, tests and retained evidence. No application source was changed, no builds/tests or endpoints were launched, and no credentials were accessed. The remaining R2 path is source-traced; a new fixture was not executed by the reviewer. Actual product-service credential precedence has not been live-tested.",
    "Independently recomputed all four supplied fingerprints and verified 528 source-inventory entries, 272 referenced artifacts, run input/log/artifact hashes, mutation input hashes and the passing C14 attempt-06 predecessor receipt chain. The integrated source fingerprint matches the tree reviewed for that C14 pass.",
    "R2's previously identified editor/auth-generated Host, forwarding, method-override and duplicate-Authorization cases are addressed with production-interface refusals before secret reads. R5 is addressed: the digest binds full authentication, workbench secret generations and cookie state; Apply re-plans after confirmation, dispatch rechecks the bindings, and the first hop uses the captured cookie. Tests exercise changed username/reference, replaced secrets including while confirmation is held, changed/cleared cookies, and unchanged approved requests.",
    "Retained logs report 344 frontend tests, 146 Rust library tests, 15 HTTP integration tests and 5 focused React Send tests passing. Four mutation baselines pass three times each, and all 48 recorded mutation probes are caught. The previously surviving managed-redirect probe now targets an unregistered loopback destination and is caught. These tests do not enforce the automatic-cookie ambiguity refusal identified in R2.",
    "All nine required C15 native checks are recorded as passing on executable edf83e81cffc722f50f859730890ae1be10296e77e3c8a0c02c6eb0a7c174c03, matching the independently hashed prepared executable. Records cover fresh Send input, cookies, large response/save, cancellation, uncertain lost response, managed destination admission, native review/confirmation, restart/history/no replay, Node-free descendants and v1 preservation.",
    "Verified the registered workload table hash and recomputed nearest-rank p95 values: response 763.31 ms, upload 116.30 ms, save 793.35 ms and responsiveness 39.71 ms; maximum process-tree RSS is 270.7 MiB. All meet the registered limits and sample counts. The responsiveness driver uses the registered URL-field target, and recorded samples complete during transfer.",
    "Native and performance evidence uses synthetic loopback services and staged folder/save-sheet paths. Production file-sheet interaction, spoken VoiceOver output, installed signed packages and live product qualification remain outside this review. The 193 catalogue entries remain request specifications. This verdict assesses C15 and does not constitute cumulative P04 approval."
  ],
